definitions.gloss: mistletoe; parasitic plant that grows on trees
definitions.explanation: A semi-parasitic evergreen plant that grows attached to the branches of host trees, drawing water and nutrients from them.

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{枝|えだ}に{宿木|やどりぎ}がついている。
examples.english: There's mistletoe growing on the tree branches.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{葉|は}が{落|お}ちた{木|き}に{宿木|やどりぎ}が{目立|めだ}つ。
examples.english: In winter, mistletoe stands out on bare trees.

examples.japanese: {西洋|せいよう}ではクリスマスに{宿木|やどりぎ}の{下|した}でキスをする{風習|ふうしゅう}がある。
examples.english: In Western culture, there is a tradition of kissing under the mistletoe at Christmas.

notes:
The word comes from {宿|やど} (lodging) + {木|ぎ} (tree), literally "a tree that lodges on another tree." Also written as {寄生木|やどりぎ}. In Japanese culture, {宿木|やどりぎ} is also known as a chapter title in The Tale of Genji ({源氏物語|げんじものがたり}), one of the later chapters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿木|やどりぎ}がつく: mistletoe attaches to (a tree)
- {宿木|やどりぎ}の{実|み}: mistletoe berries
- {宿木|やどりぎ}の{下|した}: under the mistletoe

BOTANICAL NOTE:
Mistletoe is a semi-parasite ({半寄生|はんきせい}) — it has green leaves and can photosynthesize, but it also draws water and minerals from the host tree through specialized roots.
